name: RoseTTAFold3 (RF3)

steps: Read the current Rosetta Commons Foundry RF3 installation and license documentation; select RF3 rather than the older RoseTTAFold pipeline.
Check the host GPU/PyTorch/CUDA compatibility and set up a fresh environment before installing the documented rc-foundry[rf3] extra.
Review checkpoint provenance, size and storage path before downloading model weights with the official Foundry tooling.
install.verify_note: Check the Foundry/RF3 command-line help and resolved checkpoint path; a prediction is a separate compute-heavy validation.

notes: The Foundry RF3 extra has Linux-specific dependencies; macOS MPS support documented through a community fork is not treated as a reviewed native route here.
